title: Fake-DOM piece 6: move lin-4035-live-console-client and live-console-client-facts onto loadWorld
description:
Piece 6 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Blocked on piece 0** (`getElementById`, `[attr^=]` at load, `append`, `firstElementChild`, and descriptor-copying `window`/`globals`).

### Slice of the approved plan

| path | tests | API |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `tests/unit/lin-4035-live-console-client.test.js` | 28 | `getElementById` and `[data-testid^=…]` at load (`public/live-console.js:63-91`), `append` and `firstElementChild` (`:271-280`) |
| `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js` | 12 | the same load-time APIs. It drives `updateLaneNode` only (`:1281-1321`) |

**Not a stop.** The ticket expected a stop here, but neither suite reaches the `style` (`live-console.js:338-340`, `:408`, `:482`, `:489`, `:516-519`), `getBoundingClientRect` (`:703`, `:708`, `:780`) or scroll (`:925-927`) lines. V8 coverage confirmed this at planning time. The `style` writes sit behind `applyFeed` (`:482`, `:1606`), which `poll()` reaches only once `window.api` resolves.

Globals each suite passes: a no-op `requestAnimationFrame`; `setInterval`/`clearInterval`/`cancelAnimationFrame`/`module`; `localStorage` on both `window` and the global (`:1519`); and a never-resolving `window.api` (`api: () => new Promise(() => {})`), not `fetch` (review note 4). **Add a comment in each suite** saying that the pending feed keeps `applyFeed`'s `style` writes out of reach, so a later test that resolves it knows it has hit the stop and does not add `style` to the fake.

Fake-internals replacements, each proven red under its mutation:

* `lin-4035`: `FakeEl.children`/`textOf`/`_attrs` become `textContent`, `querySelector('.lc-timeline-detail-task')` and `getAttribute`. Mutation: drop the task link (`live-console.js:276`) or the open-run/open-task links (`:279-280`). The server markup ships `hidden` and `aria-expanded="false"`, so the "collapsed" tests parse the page with those un-set first, or they pass without a client write.
* `live-console-client-facts`: `anchors[sel] === undefined` becomes `querySelector(sel) === null`. The "reused node" test becomes `classList.contains('lc-lane--pulse')`. Mutation: invert `li.classList.toggle('lc-lane--pulse', !reducedMotion)` (`:1282`); it goes red (verified at planning time).

Ports re-run at planning time: 28/28 and 12/12 with identical names. Pitfalls already hit: the client reads `window.localStorage`, and lane markup needs `.lc-lane-ws`.

**Rules for every move PR (from the plan):**

* Test names and counts stay the same. Before you touch a file: `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file> | sed -E 's/ \([0-9.]+ms\)$//' > before.txt`. After: the same into `after.txt`. Paste the empty `diff before.txt after.txt` and the pass counts into the PR. The counts must equal the plan's table.
* Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js:51`) **and** add it to the consumer paragraph in the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` header, in the same PR (LIN-4265 comment `b6dfed3e`).
* Delete both copies in each suite: its own `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` (or object-literal stubs) and its own `makeSandbox`/`load`/`vm.createContext`. Use `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js`).
* Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals. Map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards (the plan's "Fake-internals assertions" section). A replacement that cannot go red is a loosening and does not count.
* Every red that a real tree raises is a finding. The PR records each one as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Fix serializer differences (`disabled=""`, `hidden=""`, `checked=""`, escaping, parse errors on malformed markup or `<!doctype>`) in the test's regexes or fixtures, never by relaxing the fake.
* Never shim a missing shared-fake method in one file (no `doc.getElementById = …`). If you find a gap piece 0 missed, add it to `fake-dom.js` with its own `fake-dom.test.js` case, and say so on LIN-4271.
* LIN-4267/4268/4269 and the other pieces edit the same census list and header consumer paragraph. Before merge, update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must be green on the merged head.
* Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (LIN-4272 files the follow-up), `select` support in the fake, and adding `style`/`getBoundingClientRect`/scroll/real event dispatch.

### Acceptance

* 28/28 and 12/12 pass with an empty name diff.
* Their own fakes and sandboxes are deleted.
* Both census entries are removed and both files are in the consumer paragraph.
* The pending-feed comment is present, and the mutations are recorded red.
* If this is the last piece to land, `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` for this family holds only `flight-companion-client.test.js` (census 40, minus any sibling moves that have landed).

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

---

### Implemented (close-out)

Implemented as the parent's approved plan, via [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2310](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2310>) (squash-merged as `8d8bd92f`). Deviation: the "task link gone" check reads the client source for `lc-lane-task-page` plus a two-anchor pin on `laneNode`, because a querySelector-null check against a fixture is vacuous. This description had no embedded plan, research or design sections to prune (the plan lives on LIN-4271), so scope, rules and acceptance are kept as written. Full history is in the task snapshots and the comment trail. Follow-ups: LIN-4288, LIN-4289.

comments.body:
**LIN-4285 beat 1/5 (ground + baseline). No test code migrated.**

- Branch `feat/lin-4285-live-console-loadworld` off origin/main `aeb9d877`. The tree is clean.
- BEFORE baselines: lin-4035-live-console-client 28/28; live-console-client-facts 12/12. Both match the plan.
- Drift since the plan's read `473cc865`: LIN-4268 (census 55→52), LIN-4280 (52→47), LIN-4279 piece 0. Census is 47; this piece takes it to 45. None of it changes the approach. `client-world.js` now has `run(code)` and `clickOn(element)`.
- Load-time gap the plan understates: the boot path dereferences ~30 ids, and the fake returns null for missing ones. The suites need the real page markup: `renderLiveConsolePage({urlKey})`, with the doctype stripped.
- Lane `li` blocker-ish: `laneNode` is internal and only runs after a feed resolves. The suite supplies its own lane markup (a fixture mirroring `laneNode`, with a source pin). Chosen approach for beat 2 unless someone objects.
- Shared-fake note: `live-console.js:1377/:1441` use `firstChild`/`nextSibling`, which the fake does not model. These look like they are behind applyFeed, not yet traced. File on LIN-4271 if confirmed.

Migration map: scratchpad `lin-4285-beat1-migration-map.md` (path in session). Next: beat 2 (setup, real-DOM replacements, mutations).

**LIN-4285 — implementation PR up, CI green on head.**

- **PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2310 (base `main`, not merged, not Done)
- **Head SHA:** `d9362374a0e5ecfdca1af80b0ae4992f3552e7e0` (branch `feat/lin-4285-live-console-loadworld`, rebased onto `origin/main` `069585bb`)
- **CI (Tests workflow, run 42062268488), all pass on the head:** Unit tests (6m09s), E2E shard 1/4 (4m49s), 2/4 (5m51s), 3/4 (3m29s), 4/4 (4m30s), Secret scan (source) (18s), CI success (3s)
- **Suites:** `lin-4035-live-console-client` 28/28 and `live-console-client-facts` 12/12, name diffs empty against the BEFORE captures (duration_ms summary line filtered from both sides). Census tests and helper tests green.
- **Full unit suite:** branch and `origin/main` each 23,744 tests, 0 failing; passing names identical.
- **Mutation proofs:** 25 mutations, each turns at least one expected test red; table in the PR body.
- Two local commits from beats 2 and 3 are on the branch, and beat 4 was amended for the rebased census numbers.

## Review — LIN-4285

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2310 at head `d9362374a0e5ecfdca1af80b0ae4992f3552e7e0` (base `069585bb`).

CI: green on `d9362374` (Tests run 42062268488: Unit, E2E 1–4/4, Secret scan, CI success). `main` has since moved to `d537cd69` (LIN-4267). I merged it locally: no conflicts, and census + fake-dom + client-world + both suites + LIN-4267's two suites passed 200/200. CI has not yet run on the merged head.

### Scope against plan
- The diff touches exactly the 5 files: both suites, the census, the `fake-dom.js` header, and the new `helpers/live-console-world.js`. That matches the plan's slice. The new helper is a loader and fixture over `loadWorld`, not a fake DOM. The census accepts it.
- Both suites' own `FakeEl`/`makeEl`/`anchors`/`vm.createContext`/`loadClient` are gone. No per-file shim, and no `style`/`getBoundingClientRect`/scroll added. ✅
- Census: both entries removed, and both files are added to the consumer paragraph. On the merged head the list holds 32 entries. ✅
- Name diff, re-run by me (old suites taken from `origin/main` against the PR versions, `duration_ms` filtered): **28/28 empty diff, 12/12 empty diff.** ✅
- Re-ground: since the ticket was created, nothing has changed in `public/live-console.js`, `lib/render-live-console.js` or `client-world.js` apart from piece 0 (`aeb9d877`) and piece 1, which the PR is built on. Regression log is clean: nothing reverted or re-applied.
- `firstChild`/`nextSibling` (`:1377`, `:1441`): the PR traces both behind `applyFeed`/`lastFeed`, and I agree from the source. There is no shared-fake gap.

### Mutation checks (my own, each reverted; tree clean after)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| invert `lc-lane--pulse` toggle (`:1282`) | 1 red |
| drop task link in detail line (`:276`) | 1 red |
| drop "open run →" (`:279`) | 1 red |
| drop `run.hidden = false` | 1 red |
| drop `title.hidden = !lane.title` | 2 red |
| drop separator hidden write | 1 red |
| drop `activityBody.hidden` write in `paintActivity` | 4 red |
| drop toggle `aria-expanded` write | 3 red |
| drop `activityNew.hidden` write | 2 red |
| remove `.lc-lane-ws` from `LANE_CONTENTS` (pin wiring) | 10 red |

The `hidden`/`aria-expanded` strip in `pageBody` is load-bearing. Without it, a client that never writes `hidden=true` on the activity body still passes the "stays collapsed" check. With it, dropping the write turns 4 tests red.

### Findings
1. **Pending-feed comment is not in the suites.** The ticket says to "add a comment in each suite". The comment is only in the `loadLiveConsole` JSDoc in `helpers/live-console-world.js`. Neither suite mentions it: grepping both for `pending|applyFeed|style` finds nothing. The PR body's "The suites carry a comment saying so" is therefore inaccurate. **Fix for close-out:** in each of `tests/unit/lin-4035-live-console-client.test.js` and `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js`, add to the header block comment: "`window.api` never resolves here (helpers/live-console-world.js), so poll() never reaches applyFeed and its `style` writes stay out of reach. A test that resolves the feed has hit LIN-4271's stop: do not add `style` to the fake." Also correct the PR body sentence.
2. **Deviation (accepted, recorded):** the plan said "task link gone" should become `querySelector('.lc-lane-task-page') === null`. Against a fixture, that check is vacuous. The PR checks the client source for `lc-lane-task-page` instead, plus the two-anchor pin on `laneNode` (F13 red). That is at least as strict as the original check, which only proved `updateLaneNode` never queried the class. No change needed.
3. Note, no action: `pageBody` strips only bare `hidden`. If the server ever emits `hidden=""`, the strip stops silently and the collapsed tests go back to proving server markup. This is outside scope. Raising it only as a fixture caveat.

Class check: this is one piece of LIN-4271's bounded family. The remaining hand-written files belong to sibling pieces LIN-4281–4284. There is no unhandled sibling inside this ticket's slice, so the change is isolated.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside**, before the merge: CI on the merged head. `main` moved to `d537cd69` after the CI run, and the ticket's rule requires CI on the updated branch. Discharge: update the branch against `main` and get CI green on that head. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must pass (it passed locally on my merge).
- **Inside**, before the merge: the pending-feed comment in each suite (Finding 1). Discharge: add the comments and grep each suite for `applyFeed`.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The move is complete, with empty name diffs at 28/28 and 12/12. Its fakes are deleted, the census and header are updated, and the mutation proofs are real. Two things remain: the per-suite pending-feed comment, and CI on the merged head.

## Close-out — LIN-4285

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2310, squash-merged as `8d8bd92f`, pinned with `--match-head-commit aec2255b`. Review verdict was Approve, conditional on the ledger below.

**Changes I made after approval** (nobody reviews these, so each is listed):
- `c0d8b2f0`: added the pending-feed comment to the header block of `tests/unit/lin-4035-live-console-client.test.js` and `tests/unit/live-console-client-facts.test.js`. Answers review Finding 1 (comment text as the review specified: `window.api` never resolves, so `poll()` never reaches `applyFeed`, its `style` writes stay out of reach, and a test that resolves the feed has hit LIN-4271's stop).
- PR body: corrected the sentence that claimed the suites carried the comment. It now names `c0d8b2f0`. Answers Finding 1's PR-body correction.
- Three merges of `origin/main` (`39f1853a` LIN-4267, `d526477f` LIN-4284, `7a0799f0` LIN-4283, `aec2255b` LIN-4282). Each conflicted only in the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph. I kept every sibling's entries and added this PR's. The census list auto-merged. No assertion or behaviour changed.

**Ledger**
- *Inside: CI on the merged head.* CI exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). Main moved three times while I was re-running it, so I re-merged and re-ran each time. Final run 42068899881 on `aec2255b`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4/4, Secret scan, CI success all pass. Main was not ahead of that head when I merged. The census, `fake-dom`, `client-world` and both suites also passed locally on that merge (343/343 in the last pre-push run).
- *Inside: pending-feed comment.* Done (`c0d8b2f0`). On merged main `8d8bd92f`, `grep applyFeed` finds the comment in both suites.
- *Finding 2 (task-link deviation):* accepted by review, no change.
- *Finding 3 (`hidden=""` strip caveat):* outside this ticket's scope per review, filed as LIN-4288 (Low, Improvement + kind:follow-up).
- *Helper-API note from the PR (`loadWorld` markup option):* filed as LIN-4289 (Low, Improvement + kind:follow-up).
- No named monitor or rollback was recorded by review, and none is needed: the change is test-only.

**After merge:** this repo has no deploy workflow and the change touches only tests, so there is nothing to wait for. On merged main `8d8bd92f` I ran the census and both suites: 83/83 pass. The two suites still carry 28 and 12 tests with the names unchanged (review re-ran the empty name diff).

**Description:** snapshot captured (`GET /snapshots` shows the pre-prune description). The description held no embedded plan, research or design sections (the plan is on LIN-4271), so I only appended an "Implemented" stub. Scope, rules and acceptance are untouched.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4271 stays open (siblings LIN-4281 pieces remain). I made no sibling changes.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4285 (stepper)

**Outcome:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2310 squash-merged as `8d8bd92f`; LIN-4285 is Done.

**Beats run (one warm implementation session, then review and close-out):**
1. Ground + baseline: baselines 28/28 and 12/12; found that the suites need the real page markup and a suite-supplied lane fixture, since `laneNode` is unexported.
2. Migrated `lin-4035-live-console-client` onto `loadWorld` (28/28, empty name diff).
3. Migrated `live-console-client-facts` (12/12, empty name diff); the vacuous 'task link gone' check became a source pin.
4. Extracted `tests/unit/helpers/live-console-world.js`, updated the census (47 -> 45), and ran 25 mutations, each turning a test red. The full unit suite matched main by name (23,744 tests, 0 failing).
5. Pushed and opened the PR; CI green on the head.
Then: review (Approve, conditional) and close-out (merge).

**What the cross-checks caught:** beat 3/4 reported the pending-feed comment as present in the suites, but after the helper extraction it only lived in the helper JSDoc. Review found that, and close-out added the comment to both suites (`c0d8b2f0`). I confirmed `applyFeed` appears in the comment in both suites on merged main.

**Evidence:** CI on the final pre-merge head `aec2255b` (run 42068899881): Unit tests, E2E 1-4/4, Secret scan, CI success all pass. I read the PR's check rollup myself. Post-merge CI on `8d8bd92f` was still running when I last looked; a test-only change with an identical, green pre-merge head.

**Left over (filed, outside scope):** LIN-4288 (`pageBody` strips only bare `hidden`), LIN-4289 (`loadWorld` markup option). No shared-fake gap was hit.
